newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales not adequate for test-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales not adequate for test-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, few dressed basis steady, USDA said.

Inquiry moderate, demand generally light. Sales confirmed on 1,100 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 65,300 head confirmed including 16,600 head or about 26 percent contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1125 lbs 66.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1215 lbs 109.00 hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1060 lbs 66.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1125 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.25. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 109.00.
Wk to date - 65,300 last week - 45,500 last year - 73,900
